words.meaning: to send, send away, let go This is a warning prophecy - repent or the Lord will let go - put out the hand and they have a choice to take hold
words.plain: Stretch forth [Hebrew: shalach] means to send, send away, or let go. This is a warning prophecy: if Israel does not repent, the Lord will release his hold — he will 'let go,' withdraw his protecting hand. But the word also implies a choice: the Lord extends his hand, and they decide whether to take hold of it.
